```java
    private final ScreenActionAccessTypeRepository screenActionAccessTypeRepository;
    private final MenuAssignmentRepository menuAssignmentRepository;
    private final PropertiesConfig propertiesConfig;

    @Override
    public CategoryOutDto createCategory(CategoryInDto categoryInDto) {
        if (Objects.requireNonNull(VersionApiEnum.fromValue(PropertiesContext.getVersion())) == VersionApiEnum.V1) {
            return createCategoryV1(categoryInDto);
        } else {
            throw new ServiceException(ErrorCode.VERSION_API_NOT_FOUND, HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND);
        }
    }

    private CategoryOutDto createCategoryV1(CategoryInDto categoryInDto) {
        log.info("Start method createCategoryV1, category -> {}", categoryInDto);

        CategoryEntity categoryEntity = CategoryEntity.builder()
                .name(validateNameInCategoryNotExists(categoryInDto.getName()))
                .description(categoryInDto.getDescription())
                .orderItem(validatePriorityInCategoryNotExists(categoryInDto.getOrderItem()))
                .type(validateType(TypeEnum.NATURAL_PERSON.getId()))
                .collapsible(true)
                .status(validateStatus(categoryInDto.getStatusId()))
                .lastModifyApplication(propertiesConfig.getApiName())
                .lastModifyIp(PropertiesContext.getClientIp())
                .lastModifyUser(PropertiesContext.getClientUser())
                .lastModifyDate(PropertiesContext.getClientDatetime())
                .build();

        ScreenEntity screenEntity = validateScreenInCategory(categoryInDto);
        categoryEntity = categoryRepository.save(categoryEntity);

        for (Long accessTypeId : categoryInDto.getAccessTypeIds()) {
            AccessTypeEntity accessTypeEntity = validateAccessType(accessTypeId);

            CategoryAccessTypeEntity categoryAccessTypeEntity = CategoryAccessTypeEntity.builder()
                    .category(categoryEntity)
                    .accessType(accessTypeEntity)
                    .lastModifyApplication(propertiesConfig.getApiName())
                    .lastModifyIp(PropertiesContext.getClientIp())
                    .lastModifyUser(PropertiesContext.getClientUser())
                    .lastModifyDate(PropertiesContext.getClientDatetime())
                    .build();

            categoryAccessTypeRepository.save(categoryAccessTypeEntity);

            log.info("CATEGORY_ACCESS_TYPE relationship created -> categoryId={}, accessTypeId={}",
                    categoryEntity.getId(), accessTypeEntity.getId());
        }

        if (screenEntity != null) {
            categoryEntity.setCollapsible(false);
            log.info("Screen {} associated with category {}", screenEntity.getId(), categoryEntity.getId());

            MenuConfigurationEntity menuConfigurationEntity = MenuConfigurationEntity.builder()
                    .name("Menu configuration " + categoryEntity.getName())
                    .description("Menú configuration para " + categoryEntity.getDescription())
                    .enabled(true)
                    .category(categoryEntity)
                    .screen(screenEntity)
                    .module(null)
                    .submodule(null)
                    .screenAction(null)
                    .lastModifyApplication(propertiesConfig.getApiName())
                    .lastModifyIp(PropertiesContext.getClientIp())
                    .lastModifyUser(PropertiesContext.getClientUser())
                    .lastModifyDate(PropertiesContext.getClientDatetime())
                    .build();

            menuConfigurationRepository.save(menuConfigurationEntity);
            log.info("MenuConfiguration created with id {} for category {} and screen {}",
                    menuConfigurationEntity.getId(), categoryEntity.getId(), screenEntity.getId());
        }

        CategoryOutDto categoryOutDto = MapperUtil.categoryEntityToCategoryOutDto(categoryEntity);

        log.info("End method createCategoryV1, categoryInDto -> {}", categoryOutDto);

        return categoryOutDto;
    }

    private Integer validatePriorityInCategoryNotExists(Integer orderItem) {
        Optional<CategoryEntity> categoryEntity = categoryRepository.findByOrderItem(orderItem);
        if (categoryEntity.isPresent()) {
            throw new ServiceException(ErrorCode.CATEGORY_ORDERITEM_ALREADY_EXISTS, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST);
        }
        return orderItem;
    }

    private ScreenEntity validateScreenInCategory(CategoryInDto categoryInDto) {
        ScreenEntity screenEntity = null;
        if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(categoryInDto.isEnabledUrl())) {
            screenEntity = validateScreenByName(categoryInDto.getUrl());
        }
        return screenEntity;
    }

    private String validateNameInCategoryNotExists(String name) {
        Optional<CategoryEntity> categoryEntity = categoryRepository.findByName(name);
        if (categoryEntity.isPresent()) {
            throw new ServiceException(ErrorCode.CATEGORY_ALREADY_EXISTS, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST);
        }
        return name;
    }

    @Override
    public ModuleOutDto createModule(ModuleInDto moduleInDto) {
        if (Objects.requireNonNull(VersionApiEnum.fromValue(PropertiesContext.getVersion())) == VersionApiEnum.V1) {
            return createModuleV1(moduleInDto);
        } else {
            throw new ServiceException(ErrorCode.VERSION_API_NOT_FOUND, HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND);
        }
    }

    private ModuleOutDto createModuleV1(ModuleInDto moduleInDto) {
        log.info("Start method createModuleV1, module -> {}", moduleInDto);

        ModuleEntity moduleEntity = ModuleEntity.builder()
                .category(validateCategory(moduleInDto.getCategoryId()))
                .name(validateNameModuleNotExists(moduleInDto.getName()))
                .description(moduleInDto.getDescription())
                .orderItem(validatePriorityInModuleNotExists(moduleInDto.getOrderItem(), moduleInDto.getCategoryId()))
                .type(validateType(TypeEnum.NATURAL_PERSON.getId()))
                .status(validateStatus(moduleInDto.getStatusId()))
                .collapsible(true)
                .lastModifyApplication(propertiesConfig.getApiName())
                .lastModifyIp(PropertiesContext.getClientIp())
                .lastModifyUser(PropertiesContext.getClientUser())
                .lastModifyDate(PropertiesContext.getClientDatetime())
                .build();

        ScreenEntity screenEntity = validateScreenInModule(moduleInDto.isEnabledUrl(), moduleInDto.getUrl());

        moduleEntity = moduleRepository.save(moduleEntity);

        for (Long accessTypeId : moduleInDto.getAccessTypeIds()) {
            AccessTypeEntity accessTypeEntity = validateAccessType(accessTypeId);

            ModuleAccessTypeEntity moduleAccessTypeEntity = ModuleAccessTypeEntity.builder()
                    .module(moduleEntity)
                    .accessType(accessTypeEntity)
                    .lastModifyApplication(propertiesConfig.getApiName())
                    .lastModifyIp(PropertiesContext.getClientIp())
                    .lastModifyUser(PropertiesContext.getClientUser())
                    .lastModifyDate(PropertiesContext.getClientDatetime())
                    .build();

            moduleAccessTypeRepository.save(moduleAccessTypeEntity);

            log.info("MODULE_ACCESS_TYPE relationship created -> moduleId={}, accessTypeId={}",
                    moduleEntity.getId(), accessTypeEntity.getId());
        }

        if (screenEntity != null) {
            moduleEntity.setCollapsible(false);
            log.info("Screen {} associated with module {}", screenEntity.getId(), moduleEntity.getId());

            MenuConfigurationEntity menuConfigurationEntity = MenuConfigurationEntity.builder()
                    .name("Menu configuration " + moduleEntity.getName())
                    .description("Menú configuration para " + moduleEntity.getDescription())
                    .enabled(true)
                    .category(moduleEntity.getCategory())
                    .screen(screenEntity)
                    .module(moduleEntity)
                    .submodule(null)
                    .screenAction(null)
                    .lastModifyApplication(propertiesConfig.getApiName())
                    .lastModifyIp(PropertiesContext.getClientIp())
                    .lastModifyUser(PropertiesContext.getClientUser())
                    .lastModifyDate(PropertiesContext.getClientDatetime())
                    .build();

            menuConfigurationRepository.save(menuConfigurationEntity);
            log.info("MenuConfiguration created with id {} for category {} and module {} and screen {}",
                    menuConfigurationEntity.getId(), moduleEntity.getCategory().getId(), moduleEntity.getId(),
                    screenEntity.getId());
        }

        ModuleOutDto moduleOutDto = MapperUtil.moduleEntityToModuleOutDto(moduleEntity);

        log.info("End method createModuleV1, moduleOutDto -> {}", moduleOutDto);

        return moduleOutDto;
    }

    private ScreenEntity validateScreenInModule(boolean isEnabledUrl, String url) {
        ScreenEntity screenEntity = null;
        if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(isEnabledUrl)) {
            screenEntity = validateScreenByName(url);
        }
        return screenEntity;
    }

    private String validateNameModuleNotExists(String name) {
        Optional<ModuleEntity> moduleEntity = moduleRepository.findByName(name);
        if (moduleEntity.isPresent()) {
            throw new ServiceException(ErrorCode.MODULE_ALREADY_EXISTS, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST);
        }
        return name;
    }

    private Integer validatePriorityInModuleNotExists(Integer orderItem, Long categoryId) {
        Optional<ModuleEntity> moduleEntity = moduleRepository.findByOrderItem(orderItem, categoryId);
        if (moduleEntity.isPresent()) {
            throw new ServiceException(ErrorCode.MODULE_ORDERITEM_ALREADY_EXISTS, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST);
        }
        return orderItem;
    }

    private CategoryEntity validateCategory(Long id) {
        return categoryRepository.findById(id)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ServiceException(ErrorCode.CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST));
    }

    @Override
    public SubmoduleOutDto createSubmodule(SubModuleInDto submoduleInDto) {
        if (Objects.requireNonNull(VersionApiEnum.fromValue(PropertiesContext.getVersion())) == VersionApiEnum.V1) {
            return createSubModuleV1(submoduleInDto);
        } else {
            throw new ServiceException(ErrorCode.VERSION_API_NOT_FOUND, HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND);
        }
    }

    private SubmoduleOutDto createSubModuleV1(SubModuleInDto subModuleInDto) {
        log.info("Start method createSubModuleV1, submodule -> {}", subModuleInDto);

        SubmoduleEntity submoduleEntity = SubmoduleEntity.builder()
                .module(validateModule(subModuleInDto.getModuleId()))
                .name(validateNameSubmoduleNotExists(subModuleInDto.getName()))
                .description(subModuleInDto.getDescription())
                .orderItem(validatePriorityInSubModuleNotExists(subModuleInDto.getOrderItem(),
                        subModuleInDto.getModuleId()))
                .type(validateType(TypeEnum.NATURAL_PERSON.getId()))
                .status(validateStatus(subModuleInDto.getStatusId()))
                .collapsible(true)
                .lastModifyApplication(propertiesConfig.getApiName())
                .lastModifyIp(PropertiesContext.getClientIp())
                .lastModifyUser(PropertiesContext.getClientUser())
                .lastModifyDate(PropertiesContext.getClientDatetime())
                .build();

        ScreenEntity screenEntity = validateScreenInSubModule(subModuleInDto);

        submoduleEntity = submoduleRepository.save(submoduleEntity);

        List<SubmoduleAccessTypeEntity> submoduleAccessTypeEntityList = generateSubmoduleAccessTypeList(submoduleEntity,
                subModuleInDto.getAccessTypeIds());

        submoduleAccessTypeRepository.saveAll(submoduleAccessTypeEntityList);

        if (screenEntity != null) {
            submoduleEntity.setCollapsible(false);
            log.info("Screen {} associated with submodule {}", screenEntity.getId(), submoduleEntity.getId());

            MenuConfigurationEntity menuConfigurationEntity = MenuConfigurationEntity.builder()
                    .name("Menu configuration " + submoduleEntity.getName())
                    .description("Menú configuration para " + submoduleEntity.getDescription())
                    .enabled(true)
                    .category(submoduleEntity.getModule().getCategory())
                    .screen(screenEntity)
                    .module(submoduleEntity.getModule())
                    .submodule(submoduleEntity)
                    .screenAction(null)
                    .lastModifyApplication(propertiesConfig.getApiName())
                    .lastModifyIp(PropertiesContext.getClientIp())
                    .lastModifyUser(PropertiesContext.getClientUser())
                    .lastModifyDate(PropertiesContext.getClientDatetime())
                    .build();

            menuConfigurationRepository.save(menuConfigurationEntity);
            log.info(
                    "MenuConfiguration created with id {} for category {} and module {} and submodule {} and screen {}",
                    menuConfigurationEntity.getId(), null, submoduleEntity.getModule().getId(),
                    submoduleEntity.getId(), screenEntity.getId());
        }

        SubmoduleOutDto submoduleOutDto = MapperUtil.submoduleEntityToSubmoduleOutDto(submoduleEntity);

        log.info("End method createSubModuleV1, submoduleOutDto -> {}", submoduleOutDto);

        return submoduleOutDto;
    }

    private ScreenEntity validateScreenInSubModule(SubModuleInDto submoduleInDto) {
        ScreenEntity screenEntity = null;
        if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(submoduleInDto.isEnabledUrl())) {
            screenEntity = validateScreenByName(submoduleInDto.getUrl());
        }
        return screenEntity;
    }

    private ModuleEntity validateModule(Long id) {
        return moduleRepository.findById(id)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ServiceException(ErrorCode.MODULE_NOT_FOUND, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST));
    }

    private String validateNameSubmoduleNotExists(String name) {
        Optional<SubmoduleEntity> submoduleEntity = submoduleRepository.findByName(name);
        if (submoduleEntity.isPresent()) {
            throw new ServiceException(ErrorCode.SUBMODULE_ALREADY_EXISTS, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST);
        }
        return name;
    }

    private Integer validatePriorityInSubModuleNotExists(Integer orderItem, Long moduleId) {
        Optional<SubmoduleEntity> submoduleEntity = submoduleRepository.findByOrderItem(orderItem, moduleId);
        if (submoduleEntity.isPresent()) {
            throw new ServiceException(ErrorCode.SUBMODULE_ORDERITEM_ALREADY_EXISTS, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST);
        }
        return orderItem;
    }

    @Override
    public MenuConfigurationOutDto updateMenuById(Long menuId,
            MenuConfigurationUpdateInDto menuConfigurationUpdateInDto) {
        if (Objects.requireNonNull(VersionApiEnum.fromValue(PropertiesContext.getVersion())) == VersionApiEnum.V1) {
            return updateMenuByIdV1(menuId, menuConfigurationUpdateInDto);
        } else {
            throw new ServiceException(ErrorCode.VERSION_API_NOT_FOUND, HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND);
        }
    }

    private MenuConfigurationOutDto updateMenuByIdV1(Long menuId,
            MenuConfigurationUpdateInDto menuConfigurationUpdateInDto) {
        log.info("Start method updateMenuByIdV1, menuConfigurationInDto -> {}", menuConfigurationUpdateInDto);

        MenuConfigurationEntity menuConfigurationEntityLast = menuConfigurationRepository.findById(menuId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ServiceException(ErrorCode.MENU_CONFIGURATION_NOT_FOUND, HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND));

        MenuConfigurationOutDto menuConfigurationOutDto = this.updateMenu(menuConfigurationEntityLast,
                menuConfigurationUpdateInDto);

        log.info("End method updateMenuByIdV1, MenuConfigurationInDto -> {}", menuConfigurationOutDto);

        return menuConfigurationOutDto;
    }

    private MenuConfigurationOutDto updateMenu(MenuConfigurationEntity menuConfigurationEntityLast,
            MenuConfigurationUpdateInDto menuConfigurationUpdateInDto) {

        MenuConfigurationEntity menuConfigurationEntity = MenuConfigurationEntity.builder()
                .id(menuConfigurationEntityLast.getId())
                .name(menuConfigurationEntityLast.getName())
                .description(menuConfigurationEntityLast.getDescription())
                .enabled(ObjectUtils.isEmpty(menuConfigurationUpdateInDto.isEnabled())
                        ? menuConfigurationEntityLast.getEnabled()
                        : menuConfigurationUpdateInDto.isEnabled())
                .category(ObjectUtils.isEmpty(menuConfigurationUpdateInDto.getCategory())
                        ? menuConfigurationEntityLast.getCategory()
                        : validateCategoryToUpdate(menuConfigurationUpdateInDto.getCategory()))
                .module(ObjectUtils.isEmpty(menuConfigurationUpdateInDto.getModule())
                        ? menuConfigurationEntityLast.getModule()
                        : validateModuleToUpdate(menuConfigurationUpdateInDto))
                .submodule(ObjectUtils.isEmpty(menuConfigurationUpdateInDto.getSubmodule())
                        ? menuConfigurationEntityLast.getSubmodule()
                        : validateSubModuleToUpdate(menuConfigurationUpdateInDto))
                .screen(menuConfigurationEntityLast.getScreen())
                .lastModifyApplication(propertiesConfig.getApiName())
                .lastModifyIp(PropertiesContext.getClientIp())
                .lastModifyUser(PropertiesContext.getClientUser())
                .lastModifyDate(PropertiesContext.getClientDatetime())
                .build();

        ScreenEntity screenEntity;

        if (!ObjectUtils.isEmpty(menuConfigurationUpdateInDto.getCategory())
                && menuConfigurationUpdateInDto.getCategory().isEnabledUrl()) {
            screenEntity = validateScreenByName(menuConfigurationUpdateInDto.getCategory().getUrl());

            if (menuConfigurationEntity.getSubmodule() != null) {
                SubmoduleEntity submoduleEntity = menuConfigurationEntity.getSubmodule();
                submoduleEntity.setStatus(validateStatus(StatusEnum.INACTIVE.getDescription()));
                submoduleRepository.save(submoduleEntity);
            }
            if (menuConfigurationEntity.getModule() != null) {
                if (validateScreenChange(menuConfigurationEntityLast, true, false)) {
                    menuConfigurationEntity.setScreen(screenEntity);
                    ModuleEntity moduleEntity = menuConfigurationEntity.getModule();
                    moduleEntity.setStatus(validateStatus(StatusEnum.INACTIVE.getDescription()));

                    CategoryEntity categoryEntity = menuConfigurationEntity.getCategory();
                    categoryEntity.setCollapsible(false);

                    moduleRepository.save(moduleEntity);
                    categoryRepository.save(categoryEntity);
                } else {
                    throw new ServiceException(ErrorCode.SCREEN_CANT_ASSIGN, HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND);
                }

            }
            if (menuConfigurationEntity.getSubmodule() == null && menuConfigurationEntity.getModule() == null) {
                menuConfigurationEntity.setScreen(screenEntity);

                CategoryEntity categoryEntity = menuConfigurationEntity.getCategory();
                categoryEntity.setCollapsible(false);
                categoryRepository.save(categoryEntity);
            }

        } else if (!ObjectUtils.isEmpty(menuConfigurationUpdateInDto.getModule())
                && menuConfigurationUpdateInDto.getModule().isEnabledUrl()) {
            screenEntity = validateScreenByName(menuConfigurationUpdateInDto.getModule().getUrl());

            if (menuConfigurationEntity.getSubmodule() != null) {
                if (validateScreenChange(menuConfigurationEntityLast, false, true)) {
                    menuConfigurationEntity.setScreen(screenEntity);
                    SubmoduleEntity submoduleEntity = menuConfigurationEntity.getSubmodule();
                    submoduleEntity.setStatus(validateStatus(StatusEnum.INACTIVE.getDescription()));

                    ModuleEntity moduleEntity = menuConfigurationEntity.getModule();
                    moduleEntity.setCollapsible(false);

                    moduleRepository.save(moduleEntity);

                    submoduleRepository.save(submoduleEntity);
                } else {
                    throw new ServiceException(ErrorCode.SCREEN_CANT_ASSIGN, HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND);
                }

            } else {
                ModuleEntity moduleEntity = menuConfigurationEntity.getModule();
                moduleEntity.setCollapsible(false);

                moduleRepository.save(moduleEntity);
                menuConfigurationEntity.setScreen(screenEntity);
            }
        } else if (!ObjectUtils.isEmpty(menuConfigurationUpdateInDto.getSubmodule())
                && menuConfigurationUpdateInDto.getSubmodule().isEnabledUrl()) {
            screenEntity = validateScreenByName(menuConfigurationUpdateInDto.getSubmodule().getUrl());
            menuConfigurationEntity.setScreen(screenEntity);
        }

        return MapperUtil.menuConfigurationEntityToMenuConfigurationOutDto(
                menuConfigurationRepository.save(menuConfigurationEntity));
    }

    private CategoryEntity validateCategoryToUpdate(CategoryUpdateInDto categoryUpdateInDto) {

        CategoryEntity categoryEntityLast = categoryRepository.findById(categoryUpdateInDto.getId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ServiceException(ErrorCode.CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND, HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND));

        CategoryEntity categoryEntity = CategoryEntity.builder()
                .id(categoryEntityLast.getId())
                .name(validateNameCategoryToUpdate(categoryEntityLast, categoryUpdateInDto.getName()))
                .description(categoryEntityLast.getDescription())
                .collapsible(categoryEntityLast.getCollapsible())
                .orderItem(validatePriorityInCategoryToUpdate(categoryUpdateInDto.getOrderItem(), categoryEntityLast))
                .categoryDeleted(categoryEntityLast.getCategoryDeleted())
                .type(categoryEntityLast.getType())
                .status(validateStatus(categoryUpdateInDto.getStatusId()))
                .activeAccessTypes(new ArrayList<>())
                .lastModifyApplication(propertiesConfig.getApiName())
                .lastModifyIp(PropertiesContext.getClientIp())
                .lastModifyUser(PropertiesContext.getClientUser())
                .lastModifyDate(PropertiesContext.getClientDatetime())
                .build();

        List<CategoryAccessTypeEntity> newRels = generateCategoryAccessTypeList(categoryEntity,
                categoryUpdateInDto.getAccessTypeIds());

        categoryEntity.setActiveAccessTypes(newRels);

        return categoryRepository.save(categoryEntity);
    }

    private ModuleEntity validateModuleToUpdate(MenuConfigurationUpdateInDto menuConfigurationUpdateInDto) {

        ModuleEntity moduleEntityLast = moduleRepository.findById(menuConfigurationUpdateInDto.getModule().getId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ServiceException(ErrorCode.MODULE_NOT_FOUND, HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND));

        ModuleEntity moduleEntity = ModuleEntity.builder()
                .id(moduleEntityLast.getId())
                .name(validateNameModuleToUpdate(moduleEntityLast, menuConfigurationUpdateInDto.getModule().getName()))
                .description(moduleEntityLast.getDescription())
                .category(validateModuleToUpdateCategory(menuConfigurationUpdateInDto.getCategory().getId()))
                .collapsible(moduleEntityLast.getCollapsible())
                .orderItem(validatePriorityInModuletoUpdate(menuConfigurationUpdateInDto.getModule().getOrderItem(),
                        menuConfigurationUpdateInDto.getCategory().getId(), moduleEntityLast))
                .status(validateStatus(menuConfigurationUpdateInDto.getModule().getStatusId()))
                .moduleDeleted(moduleEntityLast.getModuleDeleted())
                .type(moduleEntityLast.getType())
                .activeAccessTypes(new ArrayList<>())
                .lastModifyApplication(propertiesConfig.getApiName())
                .lastModifyIp(PropertiesContext.getClientIp())
                .lastModifyUser(PropertiesContext.getClientUser())
                .lastModifyDate(PropertiesContext.getClientDatetime())
                .build();

        List<ModuleAccessTypeEntity> newRels = generateModuleAccessTypeList(moduleEntity,
                menuConfigurationUpdateInDto.getModule().getAccessTypeIds());

        moduleEntity.setActiveAccessTypes(newRels);

        return moduleRepository.save(moduleEntity);
    }

    private CategoryEntity validateModuleToUpdateCategory(Long id) {
        CategoryEntity categoryEntity = categoryRepository.findById(id)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ServiceException(ErrorCode.CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND, HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND));

        if (!categoryEntity.getCollapsible()) {
            throw new ServiceException(ErrorCode.MODULE_CANT_ASSIGN, HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND);
        }

        return categoryEntity;
    }

    private SubmoduleEntity validateSubModuleToUpdate(MenuConfigurationUpdateInDto menuConfigurationUpdateInDto) {

        SubmoduleEntity submoduleEntityLast = submoduleRepository
                .findById(menuConfigurationUpdateInDto.getSubmodule().getId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ServiceException(ErrorCode.SUBMODULE_NOT_FOUND, HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND));

        SubmoduleEntity submoduleEntity = SubmoduleEntity.builder()
                .id(submoduleEntityLast.getId())
                .name(validateNameSubmoduleToUpdate(submoduleEntityLast,
                        menuConfigurationUpdateInDto.getSubmodule().getName()))
                .description(submoduleEntityLast.getDescription())
                .module(validateSubModuleToUpdateModule(menuConfigurationUpdateInDto.getModule().getId()))
                .collapsible(submoduleEntityLast.getCollapsible())
                .orderItem(validatePriorityInSubModuletoUpdate(menuConfigurationUpdateInDto.getSubmodule().getOrderItem(),
                        menuConfigurationUpdateInDto.getModule().getId(), submoduleEntityLast))
                .status(validateStatus(menuConfigurationUpdateInDto.getSubmodule().getStatusId()))
                .submoduleDeleted(submoduleEntityLast.getSubmoduleDeleted())
                .type(submoduleEntityLast.getType())
                .activeAccessTypes(new ArrayList<>())
                .lastModifyApplication(propertiesConfig.getApiName())
                .lastModifyIp(PropertiesContext.getClientIp())
                .lastModifyUser(PropertiesContext.getClientUser())
                .lastModifyDate(PropertiesContext.getClientDatetime())
                .build();

        List<SubmoduleAccessTypeEntity> newRels = generateSubmoduleAccessTypeList(submoduleEntity,
                menuConfigurationUpdateInDto.getSubmodule().getAccessTypeIds());

        submoduleEntity.setActiveAccessTypes(newRels);

        return submoduleRepository.save(submoduleEntity);
    }

    private ModuleEntity validateSubModuleToUpdateModule(Long id) {
        ModuleEntity moduleEntity = moduleRepository.findById(id)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ServiceException(ErrorCode.MODULE_NOT_FOUND, HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND));

        if (!moduleEntity.getCollapsible()) {
            throw new ServiceException(ErrorCode.SUBMODULE_CANT_ASSIGN, HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND);
        }

        return moduleEntity;
    }

    private String validateNameSubmoduleToUpdate(SubmoduleEntity submoduleEntityLast, String name) {
        Optional<SubmoduleEntity> submoduleEntity = submoduleRepository.findByName(name);
        if (submoduleEntity.isPresent() && !submoduleEntityLast.getName().equals(submoduleEntity.get().getName())) {
            throw new ServiceException(
                    ErrorCode.SUBMODULE_ALREADY_EXISTS,
                    HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST);
        }
        return name;
    }

    private String validateNameModuleToUpdate(ModuleEntity moduleEntityLast, String name) {
        Optional<ModuleEntity> moduleEntity = moduleRepository.findByName(name);
        if (moduleEntity.isPresent() && !moduleEntityLast.getName().equals(moduleEntity.get().getName())) {
            throw new ServiceException(
                    ErrorCode.MODULE_ALREADY_EXISTS,
                    HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST);
        }
        return name;
    }

    private String validateNameCategoryToUpdate(CategoryEntity categoryEntityLast, String name) {
        Optional<CategoryEntity> categoryEntity = categoryRepository.findByName(name);
        if (categoryEntity.isPresent() && !categoryEntityLast.getName().equals(categoryEntity.get().getName())) {
            throw new ServiceException(
                    ErrorCode.CATEGORY_ALREADY_EXISTS,
                    HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST);
        }
        return name;
    }

    private Integer validatePriorityInCategoryToUpdate(Integer orderItem, CategoryEntity categoryLast) {
        Optional<CategoryEntity> categoryEntity = categoryRepository.findByOrderItem(orderItem);

        if (categoryEntity.isPresent()) {
            if (categoryLast.getOrderItem() != orderItem) {
                throw new ServiceException(
                        ErrorCode.CATEGORY_ORDERITEM_ALREADY_EXISTS,
                        HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST);
            }
        }
        return orderItem;
    }

    private Integer validatePriorityInModuletoUpdate(Integer orderItem, Long categoryId, ModuleEntity moduleLast) {
        Optional<ModuleEntity> moduleEntity = moduleRepository.findByOrderItem(orderItem, categoryId);

        if (moduleEntity.isPresent()) {
            if (moduleLast.getOrderItem() != orderItem) {
                throw new ServiceException(
                        ErrorCode.MODULE_ORDERITEM_ALREADY_EXISTS,
                        HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST);
            }
        }
        return orderItem;
    }

    private Integer validatePriorityInSubModuletoUpdate(Integer orderItem, Long moduleId,
            SubmoduleEntity submoduleEntityLast) {
        Optional<SubmoduleEntity> submoduleEntity = submoduleRepository.findByOrderItem(orderItem, moduleId);

        if (submoduleEntity.isPresent()) {
            if (submoduleEntityLast.getOrderItem() != orderItem) {
                throw new ServiceException(
                        ErrorCode.SUBMODULE_ORDERITEM_ALREADY_EXISTS,
                        HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST);
            }
        }
        return orderItem;
    }

    @Override
    public List<ScreenActionOutDto> updateScreenActionInList(Long menuId,
            List<ScreenActionUpdateInDto> screenActionUpdateInDtoList) {
        if (Objects.requireNonNull(VersionApiEnum.fromValue(PropertiesContext.getVersion())) == VersionApiEnum.V1) {
            return updateScreenActionInListV1(menuId, screenActionUpdateInDtoList);
        } else {
            throw new ServiceException(ErrorCode.VERSION_API_NOT_FOUND, HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND);
        }
    }

    private List<ScreenActionOutDto> updateScreenActionInListV1(Long menuId,
            List<ScreenActionUpdateInDto> screenActionUpdateInDtoList) {
        log.info("Start method updateScreenActionInListV1, menuId:{}, screenActionUpdateInDtoList -> {}",
                menuId, screenActionUpdateInDtoList);

        List<ScreenActionOutDto> screenActionOutDtoList = screenActionUpdateInDtoList.stream()
                .map(updateDto -> updateSingleScreenAction(menuId, updateDto))
                .toList();

        log.info("End method updateScreenActionInListV1, screenActionOutDto -> {}", screenActionOutDtoList);

        return screenActionOutDtoList;
    }

    private ScreenActionOutDto updateSingleScreenAction(Long menuId, ScreenActionUpdateInDto updateDto) {
        log.info("ScreenAction to update -> {}", updateDto);

        ScreenActionEntity lastEntity = screenActionRepository.findById(updateDto.getId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ServiceException(ErrorCode.SCREEN_ACTION_NOT_FOUND, HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND));

        List<AccessTypeEntity> accessTypeList = validateAccessType(updateDto.getAccessTypeIds());

        updateMenuAssignments(menuId, updateDto);

        ScreenActionEntity updatedScreenActionEntity = screenActionRepository
                .save(buildUpdatedScreenAction(lastEntity));

        this.updateScreenActionAccessType(updatedScreenActionEntity, accessTypeList);

        return MapperUtil.screenActionEntityToScreenActionOutDto(updatedScreenActionEntity);
    }

    private void updateMenuAssignments(Long menuId, ScreenActionUpdateInDto updateDto) {
        if (updateDto.isEnabled()) {
            List<MenuAssignmentEntity> assignments = menuAssignmentRepository
                    .findByMenuConfigurationIdAndScreenActionId(menuId, updateDto.getId());

            assignments.forEach(assignment -> {
                assignment.setEnabled(updateDto.isEnabled());
                menuAssignmentRepository.save(assignment);
            });
        }
    }

    private ScreenActionEntity buildUpdatedScreenAction(ScreenActionEntity lastEntity) {
        return ScreenActionEntity.builder()
                .id(lastEntity.getId())
                .code(lastEntity.getCode())
                .description(lastEntity.getDescription())
                .enabled(true)
                .screen(lastEntity.getScreen())
                .lastModifyApplication(propertiesConfig.getApiName())
                .lastModifyIp(PropertiesContext.getClientIp())
                .lastModifyUser(PropertiesContext.getClientUser())
                .lastModifyDate(PropertiesContext.getClientDatetime())
                .build();
    }

    private List<ScreenActionAccessTypeEntity> updateScreenActionAccessType(ScreenActionEntity screenAction,
            List<AccessTypeEntity> accessTypeList) {

        // Clear the collection - orphanRemoval handles DB deletion automatically
        if (screenAction.getActiveAccessTypeList() != null) {
            screenAction.getActiveAccessTypeList().clear();
        } else {
            screenAction.setActiveAccessTypeList(new ArrayList<>());
        }

        List<ScreenActionAccessTypeEntity> newRelations = accessTypeList.stream()
                .map(accessType -> ScreenActionAccessTypeEntity.builder()
                        .screenAction(screenAction)
                        .accessType(accessType)
                        .lastModifyApplication(propertiesConfig.getApiName())
                        .lastModifyIp(PropertiesContext.getClientIp())
                        .lastModifyUser(PropertiesContext.getClientUser())
                        .lastModifyDate(PropertiesContext.getClientDatetime())
                        .build())
                .toList();

        List<ScreenActionAccessTypeEntity> savedRelations = screenActionAccessTypeRepository.saveAll(newRelations);
        screenAction.getActiveAccessTypeList().addAll(savedRelations);

        return savedRelations;
    }

    @Override
    public MenuConfigurationOutDto updateTheLastNodeOfTree(Long menuId,
            LastNodeEnableUpdateInDto lastNodeEnableUpdateInDto) {
        if (Objects.requireNonNull(VersionApiEnum.fromValue(PropertiesContext.getVersion())) == VersionApiEnum.V1) {
            return updateTheLastNodeOfTreeV1(menuId, lastNodeEnableUpdateInDto);
        } else {
            throw new ServiceException(ErrorCode.VERSION_API_NOT_FOUND, HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND);
        }
    }

    private MenuConfigurationOutDto updateTheLastNodeOfTreeV1(Long menuId,
            LastNodeEnableUpdateInDto lastNodeEnableUpdateInDto) {
        log.info("Start method updateTheLastNodeOfTreeV1, lastNodeEnableUpdateInDto -> {}", lastNodeEnableUpdateInDto);

        MenuConfigurationEntity menuConfigurationEntity = menuConfigurationRepository.findById(menuId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ServiceException(ErrorCode.MENU_CONFIGURATION_NOT_FOUND, HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND));

        StatusEntity statusEntity = null;
        if (lastNodeEnableUpdateInDto.isEnabled()) {
            statusEntity = validateStatus(StatusEnum.ACTIVE.getDescription());
        } else {
            statusEntity = validateStatus(StatusEnum.INACTIVE.getDescription());
        }

        this.updateEntityStatusAndScreenActions(menuConfigurationEntity, menuId, statusEntity,
                lastNodeEnableUpdateInDto.isEnabled());

        log.info("End method updateTheLastNodeOfTreeV1");

        return MapperUtil.menuConfigurationEntityToMenuConfigurationOutDto(
                menuConfigurationRepository.save(menuConfigurationEntity));
    }

    private boolean validateScreenChange(MenuConfigurationEntity menuConfigurationEntity, boolean categoryToChange,
            boolean moduleToChange) {
        boolean isAllowed = false;
        if (categoryToChange) {
            List<Long> moduleEntityListIds = moduleRepository
                    .findOtherModulesInCategory(menuConfigurationEntity.getCategory().getId(),
                            menuConfigurationEntity.getModule().getId())
                    .stream()
                    .map(ModuleEntity::getId)
                    .toList();
            log.info("Looking for modules with category id: " + menuConfigurationEntity.getCategory().getId());
            log.info("Excluding the module from the same tree: " + menuConfigurationEntity.getModule().getId());
            log.info("Module ids found: {}", moduleEntityListIds);
            if (moduleEntityListIds.isEmpty()) {
                isAllowed = true;
            }
        } else if (moduleToChange) {
            List<Long> submoduleEntityListIds = submoduleRepository
                    .findOtherSubModulesInModule(menuConfigurationEntity.getModule().getId(),
                            menuConfigurationEntity.getSubmodule().getId())
                    .stream()
                    .map(SubmoduleEntity::getId)
                    .toList();
            log.info("Looking for submodules with module id: " + menuConfigurationEntity.getModule().getId());
            log.info("Excluding the submodule from the same tree: " + menuConfigurationEntity.getSubmodule().getId());
            log.info("Submodule ids found: {}", submoduleEntityListIds);
            if (submoduleEntityListIds.isEmpty()) {
                isAllowed = true;
            }
        }
        return isAllowed;
    }

    private void updateEntityStatusAndScreenActions(MenuConfigurationEntity menuConfigurationEntity,
            Long menuId, StatusEntity statusEntity, boolean isEnabled) {
        if (menuConfigurationEntity.getSubmodule() != null) {
            menuConfigurationEntity.getSubmodule().setStatus(statusEntity);
        } else if (menuConfigurationEntity.getModule() != null) {
            menuConfigurationEntity.getModule().setStatus(statusEntity);
        } else if (menuConfigurationEntity.getCategory() != null) {
            menuConfigurationEntity.getCategory().setStatus(statusEntity);
        }

        this.updateScreenActionsForMenu(menuConfigurationEntity, menuId, isEnabled);
    }

    private void updateScreenActionsForMenu(MenuConfigurationEntity menuConfigurationEntity,
            Long menuId, boolean isEnabled) {
        if (menuConfigurationEntity.getScreen() != null
                && menuConfigurationEntity.getScreen().getActions() != null) {
            for (ScreenActionEntity screenAction : menuConfigurationEntity.getScreen().getActions()) {
                this.updateMenuAssignmentsForScreenAction(menuId, screenAction.getId(), isEnabled);
            }
        }
    }

    private void updateMenuAssignmentsForScreenAction(Long menuId, Long screenActionId, boolean isEnabled) {
        List<MenuAssignmentEntity> menuAssignments = menuAssignmentRepository
                .findByMenuConfigurationIdAndScreenActionId(menuId, screenActionId);
        for (MenuAssignmentEntity menuAssignmentEntity : menuAssignments) {
            menuAssignmentEntity.setEnabled(isEnabled);
            menuAssignmentRepository.save(menuAssignmentEntity);
        }
    }

    private TypeEntity validateType(Long typeId) {
        return typeRepository.findById(typeId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ServiceException(ErrorCode.TYPE_NOT_FOUND, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST));
    }

    private StatusEntity validateStatus(Long statusId) {
        return statusRepository.findById(statusId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ServiceException(ErrorCode.STATUS_NOT_FOUND, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST));
    }

    private StatusEntity validateStatus(String name) {
        return statusRepository.findStatusInMenu(name)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ServiceException(ErrorCode.STATUS_NOT_FOUND, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST));
    }

    private AccessTypeEntity validateAccessType(Long accessTypeId) {
        return accessTypeRepository.findById(accessTypeId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ServiceException(ErrorCode.ACCESS_TYPE_NOT_FOUND, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST));
    }

    private List<AccessTypeEntity> validateAccessType(List<Long> accessTypeIds) {
        if (accessTypeIds.isEmpty()) {
            throw new ServiceException(ErrorCode.ACCESS_TYPE_NOT_FOUND, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST);
        }

        List<AccessTypeEntity> accessTypes = accessTypeRepository.findAllById(accessTypeIds);
        if (accessTypes.size() != accessTypeIds.size()) {
            throw new ServiceException(ErrorCode.ACCESS_TYPE_NOT_FOUND, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST);
        }
        return accessTypes;
    }

    private ScreenEntity validateScreenByName(String name) {
        return screenRepository.findByName(name)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ServiceException(ErrorCode.SCREEN_NOT_FOUND, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST));
    }

    private List<SubmoduleAccessTypeEntity> generateSubmoduleAccessTypeList(SubmoduleEntity submoduleEntity,
            List<Long> accessTypeIds) {
        List<SubmoduleAccessTypeEntity> submoduleAccessTypeEntities = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Long accessTypeId : accessTypeIds) {
            AccessTypeEntity accessTypeEntity = validateAccessType(accessTypeId);

            SubmoduleAccessTypeEntity submoduleAccessTypeEntity = SubmoduleAccessTypeEntity.builder()
                    .submodule(submoduleEntity)
                    .accessType(accessTypeEntity)
                    .lastModifyApplication(propertiesConfig.getApiName())
                    .lastModifyIp(PropertiesContext.getClientIp())
                    .lastModifyUser(PropertiesContext.getClientUser())
                    .lastModifyDate(PropertiesContext.getClientDatetime())
                    .build();
            submoduleAccessTypeEntities.add(submoduleAccessTypeEntity);
        }
        return submoduleAccessTypeEntities;
    }

    private List<ModuleAccessTypeEntity> generateModuleAccessTypeList(ModuleEntity moduleEntity,
            List<Long> accessTypeIds) {
        List<ModuleAccessTypeEntity> moduleAccessTypeEntities = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Long accessTypeId : accessTypeIds) {
            AccessTypeEntity accessTypeEntity = validateAccessType(accessTypeId);

            ModuleAccessTypeEntity moduleAccessTypeEntity = ModuleAccessTypeEntity.builder()
                    .module(moduleEntity)
                    .accessType(accessTypeEntity)
                    .lastModifyApplication(propertiesConfig.getApiName())
                    .lastModifyIp(PropertiesContext.getClientIp())
                    .lastModifyUser(PropertiesContext.getClientUser())
                    .lastModifyDate(PropertiesContext.getClientDatetime())
                    .build();
            moduleAccessTypeEntities.add(moduleAccessTypeEntity);
        }
        return moduleAccessTypeEntities;
    }

    private List<CategoryAccessTypeEntity> generateCategoryAccessTypeList(CategoryEntity categoryEntity,
            List<Long> accessTypeIds) {
        List<CategoryAccessTypeEntity> categoryAccessTypeEntities = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Long accessTypeId : accessTypeIds) {
            AccessTypeEntity accessTypeEntity = validateAccessType(accessTypeId);

            CategoryAccessTypeEntity categoryAccessTypeEntity = CategoryAccessTypeEntity.builder()
                    .category(categoryEntity)
                    .accessType(accessTypeEntity)
                    .lastModifyApplication(propertiesConfig.getApiName())
                    .lastModifyIp(PropertiesContext.getClientIp())
                    .lastModifyUser(PropertiesContext.getClientUser())
                    .lastModifyDate(PropertiesContext.getClientDatetime())
                    .build();
            categoryAccessTypeEntities.add(categoryAccessTypeEntity);
        }
        return categoryAccessTypeEntities;
    }

}
```

```java
package com.nubo.module.maintainer.cmd.api.web.controller;

import com.nubo.module.maintainer.cmd.api.models.dto.request.CategoryInDto;
import com.nubo.module.maintainer.cmd.api.models.dto.request.LastNodeEnableUpdateInDto;
import com.nubo.module.maintainer.cmd.api.models.dto.request.MenuConfigurationUpdateInDto;
import com.nubo.module.maintainer.cmd.api.models.dto.request.ModuleInDto;
import com.nubo.module.maintainer.cmd.api.models.dto.request.ScreenActionUpdateInDto;
import com.nubo.module.maintainer.cmd.api.models.dto.request.SubModuleInDto;
import com.nubo.module.maintainer.cmd.api.models.dto.response.CategoryOutDto;
import com.nubo.module.maintainer.cmd.api.models.dto.response.MenuConfigurationOutDto;
import com.nubo.module.maintainer.cmd.api.models.dto.response.ModuleOutDto;
import com.nubo.module.maintainer.cmd.api.models.dto.response.ScreenActionOutDto;
import com.nubo.module.maintainer.cmd.api.models.dto.response.SubmoduleOutDto;
import com.nubo.module.maintainer.cmd.api.service.MenuConfigurationService;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Content;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponse;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponses;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PatchMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

import java.util.List;

@Tag(name = "Menu")
@RequestMapping("/{version}/menu")
@RestController
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class MenuConfigurationRestController {

    private final MenuConfigurationService menuConfigurationService;

    @Operation(summary = "Create new category", description = "Create new category")
    @ApiResponses(value = {@ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "Successfully Response",
            content = @Content(mediaType = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE,
                    schema = @Schema(implementation = CategoryOutDto.class)))})
    @PostMapping("/category")
    public ResponseEntity<CategoryOutDto> createCategory(@Valid @RequestBody CategoryInDto categoryInDto){
        CategoryOutDto categoryOutDto = menuConfigurationService.createCategory(categoryInDto);
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(categoryOutDto);
    }

    @Operation(summary = "Create new module", description = "Create new module")
    @ApiResponses(value = {@ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "Successfully Response",
            content = @Content(mediaType = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE,
                    schema = @Schema(implementation = ModuleOutDto.class)))})
    @PostMapping("/module")
    public ResponseEntity<ModuleOutDto> createModule(@Valid @RequestBody ModuleInDto moduleInDto){
        ModuleOutDto moduleOutDto = menuConfigurationService.createModule(moduleInDto);
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(moduleOutDto);
    }

    @Operation(summary = "Create new submodule", description = "Create new submodule")
    @ApiResponses(value = {@ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "Successfully Response",
            content = @Content(mediaType = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE,
                    schema = @Schema(implementation = SubmoduleOutDto.class)))})
    @PostMapping("/submodule")
    public ResponseEntity<SubmoduleOutDto> createSubmodule(@Valid @RequestBody SubModuleInDto subModuleInDto){
        SubmoduleOutDto submoduleOutDto = menuConfigurationService.createSubmodule(subModuleInDto);
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(submoduleOutDto);
    }

    @Operation(summary = "Edit a menu configuration", description = "Edit a menu configuration")
    @ApiResponses(value = {@ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "Successfully Response",
            content = @Content(mediaType = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE,
                    schema = @Schema(implementation = MenuConfigurationOutDto.class)))})
    @PatchMapping("/{menuId}")
    public ResponseEntity<MenuConfigurationOutDto> updateMenuById(
        @PathVariable Long menuId,
        @Valid @RequestBody MenuConfigurationUpdateInDto menuConfigurationUpdateInDto){
        MenuConfigurationOutDto menuConfigurationOutDto = menuConfigurationService.updateMenuById(menuId, menuConfigurationUpdateInDto);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(menuConfigurationOutDto);
    }

    @Operation(summary = "Edit a accessType of action", description = "Edit a accessType of action")
    @ApiResponses(value = {@ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "Successfully Response",
            content = @Content(mediaType = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE,
                    schema = @Schema(implementation = ScreenActionOutDto[].class)))})
    @PatchMapping("/{menuId}/screenAction")
    public ResponseEntity<List<ScreenActionOutDto>> updateScreenActionInList(
        @PathVariable Long menuId,
        @Valid @RequestBody List<ScreenActionUpdateInDto> screenActionUpdateInDto){
        return ResponseEntity.ok(menuConfigurationService.updateScreenActionInList(menuId, screenActionUpdateInDto));
    }

    @Operation(summary = "Update enable of the last node of tree", description = "Update enable of the last node of tree")
    @ApiResponses(value = {@ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "Successfully Response",
            content = @Content(mediaType = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE,
                    schema = @Schema(implementation = MenuConfigurationOutDto.class)))})
    @PatchMapping("/enable/{menuId}")
    public ResponseEntity<MenuConfigurationOutDto> updateTheLastNodeOfTree(
        @PathVariable Long menuId,
        @Valid @RequestBody LastNodeEnableUpdateInDto lastNodeEnableUpdateInDto){
        return ResponseEntity.ok(menuConfigurationService.updateTheLastNodeOfTree(menuId, lastNodeEnableUpdateInDto));
    }

}
```

```yaml
      maximum-pool-size: ${DB_HIKARI_MAXIMUM_POOL_SIZE}
```

### mvnw

```
#!/bin/sh
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Licensed to the Apache Software Foundation (ASF) under one
# or more contributor license agreements.  See the NOTICE file
# distributed with this work for additional information
# regarding copyright ownership.  The ASF licenses this file
# to you under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the
# "License"); you may not use this file except in compliance
# with the License.  You may obtain a copy of the License at
#
#    http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
#
# Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing,
# software distributed under the License is distributed on an
# "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY
# KIND, either express or implied.  See the License for the
# specific language governing permissions and limitations
# under the License.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Apache Maven Wrapper startup batch script, version 3.3.4
#
# Optional ENV vars
# -----------------
#   JAVA_HOME - location of a JDK home dir, required when download maven via java source
#   MVNW_REPOURL - repo url base for downloading maven distribution
#   MVNW_USERNAME/MVNW_PASSWORD - user and password for downloading maven
#   MVNW_VERBOSE - true: enable verbose log; debug: trace the mvnw script; others: silence the output
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

set -euf
[ "${MVNW_VERBOSE-}" != debug ] || set -x

# OS specific support.
native_path() { printf %s\\n "$1"; }
case "$(uname)" in
CYGWIN* | MINGW*)
  [ -z "${JAVA_HOME-}" ] || JAVA_HOME="$(cygpath --unix "$JAVA_HOME")"
  native_path() { cygpath --path --windows "$1"; }
  ;;
esac

# set JAVACMD and JAVACCMD
set_java_home() {
  # For Cygwin and MinGW, ensure paths are in Unix format before anything is touched
  if [ -n "${JAVA_HOME-}" ]; then
    if [ -x "$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java" ]; then
      # IBM's JDK on AIX uses strange locations for the executables
      JAVACMD="$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java"
      JAVACCMD="$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/javac"
    else
      JAVACMD="$JAVA_HOME/bin/java"
      JAVACCMD="$JAVA_HOME/bin/javac"

      if [ ! -x "$JAVACMD" ] || [ ! -x "$JAVACCMD" ]; then
        echo "The JAVA_HOME environment variable is not defined correctly, so mvnw cannot run." >&2
        echo "JAVA_HOME is set to \"$JAVA_HOME\", but \"\$JAVA_HOME/bin/java\" or \"\$JAVA_HOME/bin/javac\" does not exist." >&2
        return 1
      fi
    fi
  else
    JAVACMD="$(
      'set' +e
      'unset' -f command 2>/dev/null
      'command' -v java
    )" || :
    JAVACCMD="$(
      'set' +e
      'unset' -f command 2>/dev/null
      'command' -v javac
    )" || :

    if [ ! -x "${JAVACMD-}" ] || [ ! -x "${JAVACCMD-}" ]; then
      echo "The java/javac command does not exist in PATH nor is JAVA_HOME set, so mvnw cannot run." >&2
      return 1
    fi
  fi
}

# hash string like Java String::hashCode
hash_string() {
  str="${1:-}" h=0
  while [ -n "$str" ]; do
    char="${str%"${str#?}"}"
    h=$(((h * 31 + $(LC_CTYPE=C printf %d "'$char")) % 4294967296))
    str="${str#?}"
  done
  printf %x\\n $h
}

verbose() { :; }
[ "${MVNW_VERBOSE-}" != true ] || verbose() { printf %s\\n "${1-}"; }

die() {
  printf %s\\n "$1" >&2
  exit 1
}

trim() {
  # MWRAPPER-139:
  #   Trims trailing and leading whitespace, carriage returns, tabs, and linefeeds.
  #   Needed for removing poorly interpreted newline sequences when running in more
  #   exotic environments such as mingw bash on Windows.
  printf "%s" "${1}" | tr -d '[:space:]'
}

scriptDir="$(dirname "$0")"
scriptName="$(basename "$0")"

# parse distributionUrl and optional distributionSha256Sum, requires .mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.properties
while IFS="=" read -r key value; do
  case "${key-}" in
  distributionUrl) distributionUrl=$(trim "${value-}") ;;
  distributionSha256Sum) distributionSha256Sum=$(trim "${value-}") ;;
  esac
done <"$scriptDir/.mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.properties"
[ -n "${distributionUrl-}" ] || die "cannot read distributionUrl property in $scriptDir/.mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.properties"

case "${distributionUrl##*/}" in
maven-mvnd-*bin.*)
  MVN_CMD=mvnd.sh _MVNW_REPO_PATTERN=/maven/mvnd/
  case "${PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE-}${PROCESSOR_ARCHITEW6432-}:$(uname -a)" in
  *AMD64:CYGWIN* | *AMD64:MINGW*) distributionPlatform=windows-amd64 ;;
  :Darwin*x86_64) distributionPlatform=darwin-amd64 ;;
  :Darwin*arm64) distributionPlatform=darwin-aarch64 ;;
  :Linux*x86_64*) distributionPlatform=linux-amd64 ;;
  *)
    echo "Cannot detect native platform for mvnd on $(uname)-$(uname -m), use pure java version" >&2
    distributionPlatform=linux-amd64
    ;;
  esac
  distributionUrl="${distributionUrl%-bin.*}-$distributionPlatform.zip"
  ;;
maven-mvnd-*) MVN_CMD=mvnd.sh _MVNW_REPO_PATTERN=/maven/mvnd/ ;;
*) MVN_CMD="mvn${scriptName#mvnw}" _MVNW_REPO_PATTERN=/org/apache/maven/ ;;
esac

# apply MVNW_REPOURL and calculate MAVEN_HOME
# maven home pattern: ~/.m2/wrapper/dists/{apache-maven-<version>,maven-mvnd-<version>-<platform>}/<hash>
[ -z "${MVNW_REPOURL-}" ] || distributionUrl="$MVNW_REPOURL$_MVNW_REPO_PATTERN${distributionUrl#*"$_MVNW_REPO_PATTERN"}"
distributionUrlName="${distributionUrl##*/}"
distributionUrlNameMain="${distributionUrlName%.*}"
distributionUrlNameMain="${distributionUrlNameMain%-bin}"
MAVEN_USER_HOME="${MAVEN_USER_HOME:-${HOME}/.m2}"
MAVEN_HOME="${MAVEN_USER_HOME}/wrapper/dists/${distributionUrlNameMain-}/$(hash_string "$distributionUrl")"

exec_maven() {
  unset MVNW_VERBOSE MVNW_USERNAME MVNW_PASSWORD MVNW_REPOURL || :
  exec "$MAVEN_HOME/bin/$MVN_CMD" "$@" || die "cannot exec $MAVEN_HOME/bin/$MVN_CMD"
}

if [ -d "$MAVEN_HOME" ]; then
  verbose "found existing MAVEN_HOME at $MAVEN_HOME"
  exec_maven "$@"
fi

case "${distributionUrl-}" in
*?-bin.zip | *?maven-mvnd-?*-?*.zip) ;;
*) die "distributionUrl is not valid, must match *-bin.zip or maven-mvnd-*.zip, but found '${distributionUrl-}'" ;;
esac

# prepare tmp dir
if TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR="$(mktemp -d)" && [ -d "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR" ]; then
  clean() { rm -rf -- "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR"; }
  trap clean HUP INT TERM EXIT
else
  die "cannot create temp dir"
fi

mkdir -p -- "${MAVEN_HOME%/*}"

# Download and Install Apache Maven
verbose "Couldn't find MAVEN_HOME, downloading and installing it ..."
verbose "Downloading from: $distributionUrl"
verbose "Downloading to: $TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR/$distributionUrlName"

# select .zip or .tar.gz
if ! command -v unzip >/dev/null; then
  distributionUrl="${distributionUrl%.zip}.tar.gz"
  distributionUrlName="${distributionUrl##*/}"
fi

# verbose opt
__MVNW_QUIET_WGET=--quiet __MVNW_QUIET_CURL=--silent __MVNW_QUIET_UNZIP=-q __MVNW_QUIET_TAR=''
[ "${MVNW_VERBOSE-}" != true ] || __MVNW_QUIET_WGET='' __MVNW_QUIET_CURL='' __MVNW_QUIET_UNZIP='' __MVNW_QUIET_TAR=v

# normalize http auth
case "${MVNW_PASSWORD:+has-password}" in
'') MVNW_USERNAME='' MVNW_PASSWORD='' ;;
has-password) [ -n "${MVNW_USERNAME-}" ] || MVNW_USERNAME='' MVNW_PASSWORD='' ;;
esac

if [ -z "${MVNW_USERNAME-}" ] && command -v wget >/dev/null; then
  verbose "Found wget ... using wget"
  wget ${__MVNW_QUIET_WGET:+"$__MVNW_QUIET_WGET"} "$distributionUrl" -O "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR/$distributionUrlName" || die "wget: Failed to fetch $distributionUrl"
elif [ -z "${MVNW_USERNAME-}" ] && command -v curl >/dev/null; then
  verbose "Found curl ... using curl"
  curl ${__MVNW_QUIET_CURL:+"$__MVNW_QUIET_CURL"} -f -L -o "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR/$distributionUrlName" "$distributionUrl" || die "curl: Failed to fetch $distributionUrl"
elif set_java_home; then
  verbose "Falling back to use Java to download"
  javaSource="$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR/Downloader.java"
  targetZip="$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR/$distributionUrlName"
  cat >"$javaSource" <<-END
	public class Downloader extends java.net.Authenticator
	{
	  protected java.net.PasswordAuthentication getPasswordAuthentication()
	  {
	    return new java.net.PasswordAuthentication( System.getenv( "MVNW_USERNAME" ), System.getenv( "MVNW_PASSWORD" ).toCharArray() );
	  }
	  public static void main( String[] args ) throws Exception
	  {
	    setDefault( new Downloader() );
	    java.nio.file.Files.copy( java.net.URI.create( args[0] ).toURL().openStream(), java.nio.file.Paths.get( args[1] ).toAbsolutePath().normalize() );
	  }
	}
	END
  # For Cygwin/MinGW, switch paths to Windows format before running javac and java
  verbose " - Compiling Downloader.java ..."
  "$(native_path "$JAVACCMD")" "$(native_path "$javaSource")" || die "Failed to compile Downloader.java"
  verbose " - Running Downloader.java ..."
  "$(native_path "$JAVACMD")" -cp "$(native_path "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR")" Downloader "$distributionUrl" "$(native_path "$targetZip")"
fi

# If specified, validate the SHA-256 sum of the Maven distribution zip file
if [ -n "${distributionSha256Sum-}" ]; then
  distributionSha256Result=false
  if [ "$MVN_CMD" = mvnd.sh ]; then
    echo "Checksum validation is not supported for maven-mvnd." >&2
    echo "Please disable validation by removing 'distributionSha256Sum' from your maven-wrapper.properties." >&2
    exit 1
  elif command -v sha256sum >/dev/null; then
    if echo "$distributionSha256Sum  $TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR/$distributionUrlName" | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      distributionSha256Result=true
    fi
  elif command -v shasum >/dev/null; then
    if echo "$distributionSha256Sum  $TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR/$distributionUrlName" | shasum -a 256 -c >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      distributionSha256Result=true
    fi
  else
    echo "Checksum validation was requested but neither 'sha256sum' or 'shasum' are available." >&2
    echo "Please install either command, or disable validation by removing 'distributionSha256Sum' from your maven-wrapper.properties." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  if [ $distributionSha256Result = false ]; then
    echo "Error: Failed to validate Maven distribution SHA-256, your Maven distribution might be compromised." >&2
    echo "If you updated your Maven version, you need to update the specified distributionSha256Sum property." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
fi

# unzip and move
if command -v unzip >/dev/null; then
  unzip ${__MVNW_QUIET_UNZIP:+"$__MVNW_QUIET_UNZIP"} "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR/$distributionUrlName" -d "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR" || die "failed to unzip"
else
  tar xzf${__MVNW_QUIET_TAR:+"$__MVNW_QUIET_TAR"} "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR/$distributionUrlName" -C "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR" || die "failed to untar"
fi

# Find the actual extracted directory name (handles snapshots where filename != directory name)
actualDistributionDir=""

# First try the expected directory name (for regular distributions)
if [ -d "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR/$distributionUrlNameMain" ]; then
  if [ -f "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR/$distributionUrlNameMain/bin/$MVN_CMD" ]; then
    actualDistributionDir="$distributionUrlNameMain"
  fi
fi

# If not found, search for any directory with the Maven executable (for snapshots)
if [ -z "$actualDistributionDir" ]; then
  # enable globbing to iterate over items
  set +f
  for dir in "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR"/*; do
    if [ -d "$dir" ]; then
      if [ -f "$dir/bin/$MVN_CMD" ]; then
        actualDistributionDir="$(basename "$dir")"
        break
      fi
    fi
  done
  set -f
fi

if [ -z "$actualDistributionDir" ]; then
  verbose "Contents of $TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR:"
  verbose "$(ls -la "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR")"
  die "Could not find Maven distribution directory in extracted archive"
fi

verbose "Found extracted Maven distribution directory: $actualDistributionDir"
printf %s\\n "$distributionUrl" >"$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR/$actualDistributionDir/mvnw.url"
mv -- "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR/$actualDistributionDir" "$MAVEN_HOME" || [ -d "$MAVEN_HOME" ] || die "fail to move MAVEN_HOME"

clean || :
exec_maven "$@"

```

### mvnw.cmd

```
<# : batch portion
@REM ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
@REM Licensed to the Apache Software Foundation (ASF) under one
@REM or more contributor license agreements.  See the NOTICE file
@REM distributed with this work for additional information
@REM regarding copyright ownership.  The ASF licenses this file
@REM to you under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the
@REM "License"); you may not use this file except in compliance
@REM with the License.  You may obtain a copy of the License at
@REM
@REM    http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
@REM
@REM Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing,
@REM software distributed under the License is distributed on an
@REM "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY
@REM KIND, either express or implied.  See the License for the
@REM specific language governing permissions and limitations
@REM under the License.
@REM ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

@REM ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
@REM Apache Maven Wrapper startup batch script, version 3.3.4
@REM
@REM Optional ENV vars
@REM   MVNW_REPOURL - repo url base for downloading maven distribution
@REM   MVNW_USERNAME/MVNW_PASSWORD - user and password for downloading maven
@REM   MVNW_VERBOSE - true: enable verbose log; others: silence the output
@REM ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

@IF "%__MVNW_ARG0_NAME__%"=="" (SET __MVNW_ARG0_NAME__=%~nx0)
@SET __MVNW_CMD__=
@SET __MVNW_ERROR__=
@SET __MVNW_PSMODULEP_SAVE=%PSModulePath%
@SET PSModulePath=
@FOR /F "usebackq tokens=1* delims==" %%A IN (`powershell -noprofile "& {$scriptDir='%~dp0'; $script='%__MVNW_ARG0_NAME__%'; icm -ScriptBlock ([Scriptblock]::Create((Get-Content -Raw '%~f0'))) -NoNewScope}"`) DO @(
  IF "%%A"=="MVN_CMD" (set __MVNW_CMD__=%%B) ELSE IF "%%B"=="" (echo %%A) ELSE (echo %%A=%%B)
)
@SET PSModulePath=%__MVNW_PSMODULEP_SAVE%
@SET __MVNW_PSMODULEP_SAVE=
@SET __MVNW_ARG0_NAME__=
@SET MVNW_USERNAME=
@SET MVNW_PASSWORD=
@IF NOT "%__MVNW_CMD__%"=="" ("%__MVNW_CMD__%" %*)
@echo Cannot start maven from wrapper >&2 && exit /b 1
@GOTO :EOF
: end batch / begin powershell #>

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
if ($env:MVNW_VERBOSE -eq "true") {
  $VerbosePreference = "Continue"
}

# calculate distributionUrl, requires .mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.properties
$distributionUrl = (Get-Content -Raw "$scriptDir/.mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.properties" | ConvertFrom-StringData).distributionUrl
if (!$distributionUrl) {
  Write-Error "cannot read distributionUrl property in $scriptDir/.mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.properties"
}

switch -wildcard -casesensitive ( $($distributionUrl -replace '^.*/','') ) {
  "maven-mvnd-*" {
    $USE_MVND = $true
    $distributionUrl = $distributionUrl -replace '-bin\.[^.]*$',"-windows-amd64.zip"
    $MVN_CMD = "mvnd.cmd"
    break
  }
  default {
    $USE_MVND = $false
    $MVN_CMD = $script -replace '^mvnw','mvn'
    break
  }
}

# apply MVNW_REPOURL and calculate MAVEN_HOME
# maven home pattern: ~/.m2/wrapper/dists/{apache-maven-<version>,maven-mvnd-<version>-<platform>}/<hash>
if ($env:MVNW_REPOURL) {
  $MVNW_REPO_PATTERN = if ($USE_MVND -eq $False) { "/org/apache/maven/" } else { "/maven/mvnd/" }
  $distributionUrl = "$env:MVNW_REPOURL$MVNW_REPO_PATTERN$($distributionUrl -replace "^.*$MVNW_REPO_PATTERN",'')"
}
$distributionUrlName = $distributionUrl -replace '^.*/',''
$distributionUrlNameMain = $distributionUrlName -replace '\.[^.]*$','' -replace '-bin$',''

$MAVEN_M2_PATH = "$HOME/.m2"
if ($env:MAVEN_USER_HOME) {
  $MAVEN_M2_PATH = "$env:MAVEN_USER_HOME"
}

if (-not (Test-Path -Path $MAVEN_M2_PATH)) {
    New-Item -Path $MAVEN_M2_PATH -ItemType Directory | Out-Null
}

$MAVEN_WRAPPER_DISTS = $null
if ((Get-Item $MAVEN_M2_PATH).Target[0] -eq $null) {
  $MAVEN_WRAPPER_DISTS = "$MAVEN_M2_PATH/wrapper/dists"
} else {
  $MAVEN_WRAPPER_DISTS = (Get-Item $MAVEN_M2_PATH).Target[0] + "/wrapper/dists"
}

$MAVEN_HOME_PARENT = "$MAVEN_WRAPPER_DISTS/$distributionUrlNameMain"
$MAVEN_HOME_NAME = ([System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create().ComputeHash([byte[]][char[]]$distributionUrl) | ForEach-Object {$_.ToString("x2")}) -join ''
$MAVEN_HOME = "$MAVEN_HOME_PARENT/$MAVEN_HOME_NAME"

if (Test-Path -Path "$MAVEN_HOME" -PathType Container) {
  Write-Verbose "found existing MAVEN_HOME at $MAVEN_HOME"
  Write-Output "MVN_CMD=$MAVEN_HOME/bin/$MVN_CMD"
  exit $?
}

if (! $distributionUrlNameMain -or ($distributionUrlName -eq $distributionUrlNameMain)) {
  Write-Error "distributionUrl is not valid, must end with *-bin.zip, but found $distributionUrl"
}

# prepare tmp dir
$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR_HOLDER = New-TemporaryFile
$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR = New-Item -Itemtype Directory -Path "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR_HOLDER.dir"
$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR_HOLDER.Delete() | Out-Null
trap {
  if ($TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR.Exists) {
    try { Remove-Item $TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR -Recurse -Force | Out-Null }
    catch { Write-Warning "Cannot remove $TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR" }
  }
}

New-Item -Itemtype Directory -Path "$MAVEN_HOME_PARENT" -Force | Out-Null

# Download and Install Apache Maven
Write-Verbose "Couldn't find MAVEN_HOME, downloading and installing it ..."
Write-Verbose "Downloading from: $distributionUrl"
Write-Verbose "Downloading to: $TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR/$distributionUrlName"

$webclient = New-Object System.Net.WebClient
if ($env:MVNW_USERNAME -and $env:MVNW_PASSWORD) {
  $webclient.Credentials = New-Object System.Net.NetworkCredential($env:MVNW_USERNAME, $env:MVNW_PASSWORD)
}
[Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12
$webclient.DownloadFile($distributionUrl, "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR/$distributionUrlName") | Out-Null

# If specified, validate the SHA-256 sum of the Maven distribution zip file
$distributionSha256Sum = (Get-Content -Raw "$scriptDir/.mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.properties" | ConvertFrom-StringData).distributionSha256Sum
if ($distributionSha256Sum) {
  if ($USE_MVND) {
    Write-Error "Checksum validation is not supported for maven-mvnd. `nPlease disable validation by removing 'distributionSha256Sum' from your maven-wrapper.properties."
  }
  Import-Module $PSHOME\Modules\Microsoft.PowerShell.Utility -Function Get-FileHash
  if ((Get-FileHash "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR/$distributionUrlName" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower() -ne $distributionSha256Sum) {
    Write-Error "Error: Failed to validate Maven distribution SHA-256, your Maven distribution might be compromised. If you updated your Maven version, you need to update the specified distributionSha256Sum property."
  }
}

# unzip and move
Expand-Archive "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR/$distributionUrlName" -DestinationPath "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR" | Out-Null

# Find the actual extracted directory name (handles snapshots where filename != directory name)
$actualDistributionDir = ""

# First try the expected directory name (for regular distributions)
$expectedPath = Join-Path "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR" "$distributionUrlNameMain"
$expectedMvnPath = Join-Path "$expectedPath" "bin/$MVN_CMD"
if ((Test-Path -Path $expectedPath -PathType Container) -and (Test-Path -Path $expectedMvnPath -PathType Leaf)) {
  $actualDistributionDir = $distributionUrlNameMain
}

# If not found, search for any directory with the Maven executable (for snapshots)
if (!$actualDistributionDir) {
  Get-ChildItem -Path "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR" -Directory | ForEach-Object {
    $testPath = Join-Path $_.FullName "bin/$MVN_CMD"
    if (Test-Path -Path $testPath -PathType Leaf) {
      $actualDistributionDir = $_.Name
    }
  }
}

if (!$actualDistributionDir) {
  Write-Error "Could not find Maven distribution directory in extracted archive"
}

Write-Verbose "Found extracted Maven distribution directory: $actualDistributionDir"
Rename-Item -Path "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR/$actualDistributionDir" -NewName $MAVEN_HOME_NAME | Out-Null
try {
  Move-Item -Path "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR/$MAVEN_HOME_NAME" -Destination $MAVEN_HOME_PARENT | Out-Null
} catch {
  if (! (Test-Path -Path "$MAVEN_HOME" -PathType Container)) {
    Write-Error "fail to move MAVEN_HOME"
  }
} finally {
  try { Remove-Item $TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR -Recurse -Force | Out-Null }
  catch { Write-Warning "Cannot remove $TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR" }
}

Write-Output "MVN_CMD=$MAVEN_HOME/bin/$MVN_CMD"
```

```java
package com.nubo.module.maintainer.query.api.application.config;

import com.nubo.module.maintainer.query.api.exception.error.ErrorResponse;
import com.nubo.module.maintainer.query.api.exception.error.ErrorValidation;
import com.nubo.module.maintainer.query.api.models.enums.PropertiesEnum;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Hidden;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.enums.ParameterIn;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.models.Components;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.models.OpenAPI;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.models.info.Info;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.models.media.Content;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.models.media.MediaType;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.models.media.Schema;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.models.parameters.HeaderParameter;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.models.parameters.Parameter;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.models.responses.ApiResponse;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.models.security.SecurityRequirement;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.models.security.SecurityScheme;
import org.springdoc.core.customizers.GlobalOpenApiCustomizer;
import org.springdoc.core.models.GroupedOpenApi;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Controller;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.servlet.ModelAndView;

import java.util.List;

@Configuration
@Controller
public class SwaggerConfig {

    @GetMapping(value = "/")
    @Hidden
    @Operation(description = "Redirect to api home page")
    public ModelAndView index() {
        return new ModelAndView("redirect:/swagger-ui/index.html");
    }

    @Bean
    public GroupedOpenApi publicApi(@Value("${application.group}") String appGroup) {
        return GroupedOpenApi.builder().group(appGroup).pathsToMatch("/**").build();
    }

    @Bean
    public OpenAPI customOpenAPI(
            @Value("${application.title}") String appTitle,
            @Value("${application.description}") String appDescription,
            @Value("${application.version}") String appVersion) {
        final String securitySchemeName = "bearerAuth";

        return new OpenAPI()
                .addSecurityItem(new SecurityRequirement().addList(securitySchemeName))
                .components(new Components()
                        .addSecuritySchemes(securitySchemeName, new SecurityScheme()
                                .name(securitySchemeName).type(SecurityScheme.Type.HTTP)
                                .scheme("bearer").bearerFormat("JWT")))
                .info(new Info()
                        .title(appTitle)
                        .description(appDescription)
                        .version(appVersion));
    }

    @Bean
    public GlobalOpenApiCustomizer customizer() {
        Content content = createErrorResponse();
        return openApi -> openApi.getPaths().values().stream().flatMap(pathItem -> pathItem.readOperations().stream())
                .forEach(operation -> {
                    operation.addParametersItem(new HeaderParameter().name(PropertiesEnum.CLIENT_IP.getValue())
                                    .in(ParameterIn.HEADER.toString()).required(true).example("127.0.0.1"))
                            .addParametersItem(new HeaderParameter().name(PropertiesEnum.CLIENT_USER.getValue())
                                    .in(ParameterIn.HEADER.toString()).required(true).example("admin"))
                            .addParametersItem(new HeaderParameter().name(PropertiesEnum.CLIENT_DATETIME.getValue())
                                    .in(ParameterIn.HEADER.toString()).required(true).example("2024-09-11T15:30:00"))
                            .addParametersItem(new Parameter().name("version").in(ParameterIn.PATH.toString())
                                    .required(true).example("v1"))
                            .getResponses()
                            .addApiResponse("500", new ApiResponse().description("Error Response").content(content));
                });
    }

    private Content createErrorResponse() {
        var errorValidationSchema = new Schema<ErrorValidation>()
                .addProperty("id", new Schema<String>())
                .addProperty("description", new Schema<String>());
        var errorDetailsSchema = new Schema<List<ErrorValidation>>()
                .items(errorValidationSchema);
        var errorResponseSchema = new Schema<ErrorResponse>()
                .addProperty("httpCode", new Schema<String>())
                .addProperty("httpMethod", new Schema<String>())
                .addProperty("url", new Schema<String>())
                .addProperty("timestamp", new Schema<String>())
                .addProperty("errorCode", new Schema<String>())
                .addProperty("errorMessage", new Schema<String>())
                .addProperty("errorMessageDetail", new Schema<String>())
                .addProperty("errorDetails", errorDetailsSchema);
        return new Content().addMediaType("application/json", new MediaType().schema(errorResponseSchema));
    }

}
```

```java
package com.nubo.module.maintainer.query.api.application.config;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Profile;
import org.springframework.http.HttpMethod;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestClient;
import org.springframework.web.servlet.LocaleResolver;
import org.springframework.web.servlet.config.annotation.CorsRegistry;
import org.springframework.web.servlet.config.annotation.WebMvcConfigurer;
import org.springframework.web.servlet.i18n.SessionLocaleResolver;

import java.util.Locale;

@Configuration
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class WebConfig implements WebMvcConfigurer {

    @Bean
    public LocaleResolver localeResolver() {
        SessionLocaleResolver slr = new SessionLocaleResolver();
        slr.setDefaultLocale(Locale.ENGLISH);
        return slr;
    }

    @Bean
    public RestClient restClient() {
        return RestClient.create();
    }
```
